question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as a goal
Great accomplishment is associated with this attainment
The result is becoming dear to the yoginīs
inference: Attaining the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
